trace.name: commute
trace.text:
On the way to work

Freezing sleet cuts into your face while waiting twenty minutes for the delayed Route 14 bus. A passing delivery van splashes dirty curb water across your ankles.

Your damp socks stay cold all morning. Your teeth chatter as you board.

Arrive at work

trace.name: work
trace.text:
Your shift

Standard cardboard cartons slide down the rollers at a predictable cadence. No backlogs, no equipment alarms. You find an even, automatic rhythm. The break clock ticks down steadily. You finish the third pallet exactly on schedule.

Everything clicks: tape dispensers glide without tangling, labels stick cleanly, and your station finishes the freight run fifteen minutes before the final truck departure. You take a leisurely stretch and lean against the clean workbench.

Complete shift
